raw_segments.text: A sneer, however, whether covert or open, had now no longer that power over me at once
As I sat between my cousins, I was surprised to find how easy I felt under the total neglect
of the one and the semi-sarcastic attentions of the other.
Eliza did not mortify, nor Georgiana ruffle me.
The fact was, I had other things to think about.
Within the last few months, feelings had been stirred in me so much more potent than any
Pains and pleasures, so much more acute and exquisite had been excited than any it was
